items.questionZh: 說話的人點了什麼飲料？

items.sentenceEn: Cut the melon into small pieces.

items.sentenceZh: 你的飯要不要加點辣椒？

items.stemEn: On a hot day, I like a cold glass of ____.

items.passageEn: Every Friday night, Tom's family has a big dinner. Last week, his mother made a chicken curry with a little chili, and his father cooked spaghetti. For dessert, they had melon and orange jelly. The kids drank lemonade. Tom's grandmother doesn't eat chili, so she only had boiled vegetables and rice.
items.passageZh: 每週五晚上，Tom 家都會吃一頓豐盛的晚餐。上週，他媽媽做了加一點辣椒的雞肉咖哩，爸爸煮了義大利麵。甜點是哈密瓜和柳橙果凍。孩子們喝檸檬水。Tom 的奶奶不吃辣椒，所以她只吃了水煮蔬菜和白飯。

rubricZh: 「很甜」可寫例如 very sweet、really sweet

items.promptZh: 我們昨天晚餐吃義大利麵。
referenceEn: We had spaghetti for dinner yesterday.
Yesterday, we ate spaghetti for dinner.
rubricZh: 用 spaghetti 表示「義大利麵」，spaghetti 不可數，不加 s
昨天的事用過去式（例如 had、ate 等）
「晚餐吃…」可寫，例如 had…for dinner、ate…for dinner 等
